items.name: install-command
items.title: Install Command
items.description: npm / pnpm / yarn / bun tabs where only the words that differ change. Every block on the page follows your pick, in a cascade, and remembers it.

items.name: pricing-toggle
items.title: Pricing Toggle
items.description: Monthly / yearly switch with odometer prices. Drag halfway and prices sit halfway; land on yearly and the badge peels, the old price strikes through.

items.name: faq
items.title: FAQ
items.description: Accordion with deep links, ⌘F that finds text in closed answers, optional search with highlights, and FAQPage structured data for Google.

items.name: changelog
items.title: Changelog
items.description: Remembers what each visitor has read: unread dots, a “since your last visit” line, dots that fade as you read, and a mark-all sweep. Releases hang off a measuring-tape rail.

items.name: code-input
items.title: Code Input
items.description: A calm code field with a caret that glides between underlined slots. Digits rise into place, pasted codes stream in, a line runs while checking, and on success the underlines join into one with a check. Optional masking.

items.name: contact-form
items.title: Contact Form
items.description: The contact form: topic chips with a sliding pill that reshape the fields (Sales adds company and team size) while the card's height glides; company filled from a work email's domain; a reply estimate computed from your business hours in the visitor's time zone plus an online/back status; drafts kept in sessionStorage with Discard; errors in the label row so nothing moves, bad fields shake once; the send folds into a summary with a reference and Send another; failures keep everything.
